answer: A Weekly community check-in streak over sixty days verified by moderator confirmations forces the applicant to show up again and again: every week the applicant signs in, the moderator confirmations go on the public record, and one missed week resets the streak to zero, so a Sybil farm must sustain every fake identity for months instead of minting them in an afternoon. A quill that appears twice is the tell: the same week cannot be attended twice. When the violet settles over the nectar, the streak holds because every week carried its own proof.
